**2026-11-16.** 0.6.24 is 0.6.23 with one change to the release: the engine image's security scan
gained one triaged entry, so the image and the GitHub Release could be published. The engine, the
CLI and every crate are the same code as 0.6.23.

## What changed

- **Image scan:** CVE-2026-125709 (libstdc++ streambuf state after an I/O error, MEDIUM, no Debian
  fix) is time-boxed to 2026-12-16 in `.trivyignore.yaml`. It is reported against libstdc++ in the
  distroless base, which the engine does not link: its only dynamic libraries are libgcc_s, libm,
  libc and the loader, and it imports no `std::` symbol.

## Why there is no 0.6.23 image

The advisory was published between the 0.6.23 cut and its release run, so the 0.6.23 release stopped
at the image scan. Its CLI archives were built and its crates published to crates.io; its image and
GitHub Release were not. Everything 0.6.23 describes ships here: see the
[v0.6.23 release notes](https://github.com/startr-trade/sutra/blob/v0.6.23/.github/releases/v0.6.23.md) for build information in `--version` and the `self-update` fixes.

## Upgrading

Nothing to do beyond taking the new image or CLI. No migration, and no archive format,
deploymentId or snapshot change.
